source: game archive Data1: event/common.emevd.dcx, event 970 init rows (2000[0] <slot>,970,<flag>,...): the 26 boss-defeated event flags; 22 of them are also the first argument of the map events that call template 20005500 (the boss fight). Extracted read-only with I-0068/Recover-NamedGameData.ps1 and dumped with I-0067/Get-EmevdDump.ps1 (2026-10-22). The flag ids are STATIC; the English names (Thomas: the game's own English names, no translations) are INFERRED from the map and the order of the ids; where the id order does not tell which of two bosses of a map it is, the entry says so and stays 'unknown' until the boss is seen in its arena after the revive.
